-- Copyright (c) 2019 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module Asset where

type IouId = ContractId Iou
type ItemId = ContractId Item

template Iou
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
    amount : Decimal
    currency : Text
  where
    signatory issuer
    controller owner can
      TransferIou : ContractId Iou
        with newOwner : Party
        do create this with owner = newOwner

template Item
  with
    producer : Party
    owner : Party
    label : Text
    quantity : Decimal
    unit : Text
    observers : [Party]
  where
    signatory producer
    observer observers
    controller owner can
      TransferItem : ItemId
        with newOwner : Party
        do create this with owner = newOwner
      Disclose : ItemId
        with users : [Party]
        do create this with observers = users

template Offer
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
    itemId : ItemId
    price : Decimal
    currency : Text
    users : [Party]
  where
    signatory owner, vendor
    observer users
    controller owner can
      Settle : ItemId
        with buyer : Party
        do
          exercise itemId TransferItem with newOwner = buyer

-- Copyright (c) 2019 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module Shop where

import DA.Assert
import Asset

type ShopId = ContractId Shop
type OfferId = ContractId Offer
type VendorInviteId = ContractId VendorInvite
type VendorRelationshipId = ContractId VendorRelationship
type UserInviteId = ContractId UserInvite
type UserRelationshipId = ContractId UserRelationship

template Shop
  with
    owner : Party
    vendors : [Party]
    users : [Party]
    offerIds : [OfferId]
  where
    signatory owner
    observer users, vendors
    controller owner can
      InviteVendor : (ShopId, VendorInviteId)
        with vendor : Party
        do
          shopId <- create this with vendors = vendor :: vendors
          invite <- create VendorInvite with ..
          pure (shopId, invite)
      InviteUser : (ShopId, UserInviteId)
        with user : Party
        do
          shopId <- create this with users = user :: users
          inviteId <- create UserInvite with ..
          pure (shopId, inviteId)

template VendorInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    controller vendor can
      AcceptVendorInvite : VendorRelationshipId
        do create VendorRelationship with ..

template VendorRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner, vendor
    controller vendor can
      nonconsuming OfferItem : (ShopId, OfferId)
        with
          shopId : ShopId
          itemId : ItemId
          price : Decimal
          currency : Text
        do
          shop <- fetch shopId
          disclosedItemId <- exercise itemId Disclose with users = owner :: shop.users
          offerId <- create Offer with itemId = disclosedItemId; users = shop.users; ..
          shopId <- create shop with offerIds = offerId :: shop.offerIds
          pure (shopId, offerId)
          
template UserInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    controller user can
      AcceptUserInvite : UserRelationshipId
        do create UserRelationship with ..

template UserRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner, user
    controller user can
      nonconsuming BuyItem : (ShopId, ItemId, IouId)
        with
          shopId : ShopId
          offerId : OfferId
          iouId : IouId
        do
          shop <- fetch shopId
          offer <- fetch offerId
          iou <- fetch iouId
          offer.price === iou.amount
          offer.currency === iou.currency
          assert $ any (== offerId) shop.offerIds

          newShopId <- create shop with offerIds = filter (/= offerId) shop.offerIds
          newItemId <- exercise offerId Settle with buyer = user
          newIouId <- exercise iouId TransferIou with newOwner = offer.vendor
          pure (newShopId, newItemId, newIouId)

module Shop where

import Asset

type ShopId = ContractId Shop
type OfferId = ContractId Offer
type VendorRelationshipId = ContractId VendorRelationship
type UserRelationshipId = ContractId UserRelationship

template Shop
  with
    owner : Party
    vendors : [Party]
    users : [Party]
    offerIds : [ContractId Offer]
  where
    signatory owner
    observer vendors, users

    choice InviteVendor : (ContractId Shop, ContractId VendorInvite)
      with vendor : Party
      controller owner
      do
        assert (not (vendor `elem` vendors))
        newShopId <- create this with vendors = vendor :: vendors
        inviteId <- create VendorInvite with owner; vendor
        pure (newShopId, inviteId)

    choice InviteUser : (ContractId Shop, ContractId UserInvite)
      with user : Party
      controller owner
      do
        assert (not (user `elem` users))
        newShopId <- create this with users = user :: users
        inviteId <- create UserInvite with owner; user
        pure (newShopId, inviteId)

    choice AddOffer : ContractId Shop
      with
        vendor : Party
        offerId : ContractId Offer
      controller vendor
      do
        assert (vendor `elem` vendors)
        create this with offerIds = offerId :: offerIds

template VendorInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    observer vendor

    choice AcceptVendorInvite : ContractId VendorRelationship
      controller vendor
      do create VendorRelationship with owner; vendor

template UserInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    observer user

    choice AcceptUserInvite : ContractId UserRelationship
      controller user
      do create UserRelationship with owner; user

template VendorRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner, vendor

    nonconsuming choice OfferItem : (ContractId Shop, ContractId Offer)
      with
        shopId : ContractId Shop
        itemId : ContractId Item
        price : Decimal
        currency : Text
      controller vendor
      do
        shop <- fetch shopId
        item <- fetch itemId
        assert (shop.owner == owner && vendor `elem` shop.vendors)
        assert (item.owner == vendor && price > 0.0)
        offeredItemId <- exercise itemId ShareItem with newObservers = shop.users
        offerId <- create Offer with
          vendor
          shopId
          itemId = offeredItemId
          price
          currency
          observers = shop.owner :: shop.users
        newShopId <- exercise shopId AddOffer with vendor; offerId
        pure (newShopId, offerId)

template UserRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner, user

    nonconsuming choice BuyItem : (ContractId Shop, ContractId Item, ContractId Iou)
      with
        shopId : ContractId Shop
        offerId : ContractId Offer
        iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller user
      do
        shop <- fetch shopId
        offer <- fetch offerId
        assert (shop.owner == owner && user `elem` shop.users)
        assert (offerId `elem` shop.offerIds)
        (itemId, newIouId) <- exercise offerId Purchase with user; iouId
        pure (shopId, itemId, newIouId)

template Offer
  with
    vendor : Party
    shopId : ContractId Shop
    itemId : ContractId Item
    price : Decimal
    currency : Text
    observers : [Party]
  where
    signatory vendor
    observer observers

    choice Purchase : (ContractId Item, ContractId Iou)
      with
        user : Party
        iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller user
      do
        iou <- fetch iouId
        assert (iou.owner == user && iou.amount == price && iou.currency == currency)
        newItemId <- exercise itemId TransferItem with newOwner = user
        newIouId <- exercise iouId TransferIou with newOwner = vendor
        pure (newItemId, newIouId)
